tone.notes: Casual selfie-vlog voice with real details; jokes are about the experience (no soap), and the enslaved workers are mentioned plainly, not as a joke. Rating lands as a point about Roman life.

banned_topics.notes: No gore, no jokes about victims, no glorifying; slavery stated factually and briefly.

visuals.notes: Roman street and bathhouse settings read clearly; selfie shots keep Tilly's face above the caption; signs and lettering legible; background bathers are now varied strangers.

character.notes: Tilly on-model (red cap, mustard tunic, curly hair, phone) in every scene; mouth follows the voice.

learnings: Selfie shots (hold phone, scale 2.0) at the start and end make the vlog format instantly readable — keep both bookends.
Crowd scenes sell scale (~1,600 bathers) better than a number alone; use 3–4 background figures.
Hand-lettered labels inside the bathhouse sit on the vault line; place sky text at y ≤ 0.16 in 'baths' scenes.
